paper_title: A Scythe for harvesting OAI-PMH repositories

# oaipmh-scythe: A Scythe for harvesting OAI-PMH repositories

Welcome to `oaipmh-scythe`, an updated and modernized version of the original
[sickle](https://github.com/mloesch/sickle), now with additional features and ongoing maintenance.

| __CI__      | [![ci][ci-[REDACTED]]][ci-workflow] [![coverage][coverage-[REDACTED]]][ci-workflow] [![codeql][codeql-[REDACTED]]][codeql-workflow]                                             |
| :---------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| __Package__ | [![pypi-version][pypi-version-[REDACTED]]][pypi-url] [![pypi-python-versions][pypi-python-versions-[REDACTED]]][pypi-url] [![all-downloads][all-downloads-[REDACTED]]][pepy-tech-url] [![monthly-downloads][monthly-downloads-[REDACTED]]][pepy-tech-url] |
| __Meta__    | [![doi][doi-[REDACTED]]][doi-url] [![OpenSSF Scorecard][scorecard-[REDACTED]]][scorecard-url] [![uv][uv-[REDACTED]]][uv] [![ruff][ruff-[REDACTED]]][ruff] [![ty][ty-[REDACTED]]][ty] [![prek][prek-[REDACTED]]][prek-url] [![License][license-[REDACTED]]][license]                                |

`oaipmh-scythe` is a lightweight [OAI-PMH](http://www.openarchives.org/OAI/openarchivesprotocol.html) client library
written in Python. It has been designed for conveniently retrieving data from OAI interfaces the Pythonic way:

```python
from oaipmh_scythe import Scythe

with Scythe("https://zenodo.org/oai2d") as scythe:
    records = scythe.list_records()
    next(records)
# <Record oai:zenodo.org:4574771>
```

## Features

- Easy harvesting of OAI-compliant interfaces
- Support for all six OAI verbs
- Convenient object representations of OAI items (records, headers, sets, ...)
- Automatic de-serialization of Dublin Core-encoded metadata payloads to Python dictionaries
- Option for ignoring deleted items

## Requirements

[Python](https://www.python.org/downloads/) >= 3.10

`oaipmh-scythe` is built with:

- [httpx2](https://github.com/pydantic/httpx2) for issuing HTTP requests
- [lxml](https://github.com/lxml/lxml) for parsing XML responses

## Installation

You can install `oaipmh-scythe` from [PyPI][pypi-url] using [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

```console
uv add oaipmh-scythe
```

or with [pip](https://github.com/pypa/pip):

```console
python -m pip install oaipmh-scythe
```

## Documentation

The [documentation][docs-url] is made with [Zensical](https://github.com/zensical/zensical) and is
hosted by [GitHub Pages](https://docs.github.com/en/pages).

## Similar Projects

There are a couple of similar projects available on [PyPI](https://pypi.org/search/?q=oai-pmh) and GitHub, e.g. via the
topics [oai-pmh](https://github.com/topics/oai-pmh) and [oai-pmh-client](https://github.com/topics/oai-pmh-client).
Among them are these implementations in Python:

| Project                                                                          | Description                           | Last commit                                                                                           |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [sickle](https://github.com/mloesch/sickle)                                      | `oaipmh-scythe` is a fork of `sickle` | ![last-commit]([REDACTED]                              |
| [pyoai](https://github.com/infrae/pyoai)                                         | `sickle` was inspired by `pyoai`      | ![last-commit]([REDACTED]                                |
| [oaipmh](https://github.com/eth-library/oaipmh)                                  | `oaipmh` is a fork of `pyoai`         | ![last-commit]([REDACTED]                          |
| [pyoaiharvester](https://github.com/vphill/pyoaiharvester)                       | oai-pmh harvester CLI                 | ![last-commit]([REDACTED]                       |
| [ddblabs-ometha](https://github.com/Deutsche-Digitale-Bibliothek/ddblabs-ometha) | oai-pmh harvester with CLI and TUI    | ![last-commit]([REDACTED] |
| [oai-harvest](https://github.com/bloomonkey/oai-harvest)                         | uses `pyoai` internally               | ![last-commit]([REDACTED]                      |
| [oai-pmh-harvester](https://github.com/MITLibraries/oai-pmh-harvester)           | uses `sickle` internally              | ![last-commit]([REDACTED]              |

There are also similar projects available in [Java](https://github.com/topics/oai-pmh-client?l=java), [PHP](https://github.com/topics/oai-pmh-client?l=php) and [Rust](https://crates.io/crates/oai-pmh).

## Acknowledgments

This is a fork of [sickle](https://github.com/mloesch/sickle) which was originally written by Mathias Loesch.
